output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, IBM’s latest reported acquisition is UK cybersecurity consultancy Logiq Consulting, announced September 24, 2026. Other completed acquisitions in 2026 include HRL Laboratories (August 26) and Confluent (March 17). Earlier purchases include Hakkoda (closed April 2, 2025), HashiCorp (completed February 27, 2025), Kubecost (announced September 17, 2024) and SiXworks (announced July 9, 2024). A major older acquisition is Red Hat, completed July 9, 2019.
caveats: This is a selected list of recent acquisitions and a major historical transaction, not IBM’s complete acquisition history.
Announcement dates are identified separately from explicitly reported closing dates; an acquisition announcement does not necessarily establish its exact legal closing date.

key_facts.fact: IBM announced its acquisition of Logiq Consulting, a UK cybersecurity consultancy.
IBM announced completion of its acquisition of HRL Laboratories.
IBM completed its acquisition of Confluent.
IBM’s acquisition of Hakkoda closed April 2, 2025; IBM announced it on April 7.
IBM announced completion of its acquisition of HashiCorp.
IBM announced its acquisition of Kubecost.
IBM announced it had acquired SiXworks Limited.
IBM and Red Hat announced that IBM’s acquisition of Red Hat had closed.
